texts: On day 300 of Year 1, the keepers of the Harbor Row together lit the lanterns of the Harbor Row at sundown.
The lanterns showed mist-light at night.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the Harbor Row.
Three sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The three sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row in summer.
The nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank.
The surviving nightmoths fled to the Hollows.
The surviving nightmoths reached the Hollows.
The three sky-cats molted during the hunt.
The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns of the Harbor Row.

q1_issues.issue: "reached the Hollows" has a bare direct object, which the instruction set's own worked example encodes as (Theme sk_reach_1 sk_platform_1); Goal is the head for a spatial "to"-oblique and mis-slots the object here.

Definite/indefinite plural subjects with distributive predicates get no per-member distribution rule (burned 14-17, showed 23-27, survived 62-65, fled 67-70, reached 71-74, left 83-87) even though the same rule form is emitted for the sky-cat group at 49, 56 and 79.
"The mist-light" is a definite, specific referent but is filled by the bare kind symbol mist_light, which also occupies a class slot at statement 18, so one symbol serves as both kind and individual.
"left silken threads on the lanterns" makes the threads Patient, but they are deposited unchanged, and the "does the object change?" test plus the default-to-Theme rule point to Theme.

q2_gaps: An ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("On day 300 of Year 1") — the Time section defines (Day n) as a day-of-month term composing with Month/Year, and gives no form for a day number counted within a year.

A mass noun re-mentioned as a definite referent and filling a subject role ("produced mist-light" ... "The mist-light attracted nightmoths") — the Existential section says a definite mints a typed sk_ witness while a non-specific mass object stays a bare kind constant, and nothing decides which applies.
review.notes: Name handling (Harbor Row, the plural-label Hollows), group/cardinality shape, compound decomposition, day-part times and the collective reading of "together" all follow the instruction set closely. The pre-nominal participle in "the surviving nightmoths" is recorded nowhere, though Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated modifier.

issues.reason: "reached the Hollows" is a bare direct object and Thematic roles reserve Goal for a spatial "to"-oblique ("the direct-object roles are for objects the verb takes without a preposition"), with the instruction set's own worked example encoding "Sara reached the platform" as (Theme sk_reach_1 sk_platform_1).

Quantifiers, generics & scope states that the same rule form distributes a distributive predicate over "a grouped / counted plural" ("the dogs barked"), and Cardinality says such a plural keeps the group event and ADDS the per-member rule, so burn, show, survive, flee, reach and leave each owe an (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (And ...)) rule that only the sky-cat events received.

The half that stands: "The mist-light" is a specific definite, which Existential encodes as a typed sk_ individual and says to "never" fill with a bare class symbol; the half that is overstated: the kind/individual dual role is not itself ill-typed, since (Inheritance mist_light light) is mandatory compound decomposition and the earlier bare-mass fillers in "produced / showed mist-light" are the licensed non-specific kind filler.

Threads deposited on a lantern are not created, destroyed, consumed or physically changed by the leaving, so the stated "does the object itself change?" test - and its explicit "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" fallback - gives Theme, not Patient.

gaps_confirmed: Day-of-year ordinal date ("day 300 of Year 1"): the Time terms define (Day n) only as a day-of-month composing with Month/Year, so a day counted within a year has no licensed granularity term.

Mass-noun anaphora: nothing links a bare-kind mass mention ("produced mist-light") to a later definite re-mention ("The mist-light"), which the definite rule would make a fresh witness with no connection back to the kind filler.
new_gaps: Agent-nominalization taking an of-phrase that names its underlying object ("the keepers of the Harbor Row"): Complements of nouns and adjectives scopes the (Of ...) oblique to act/result/quality nominalizations and the Possession genitive to relational nouns "where no underlying verb exists", so an agent noun that does have a live underlying verb falls between the two rules and nothing decides the head.

Collective "together" on a group-witness subject ("the keepers ... together lit", "Together, the lanterns produced") has no positive carrier: with a single group symbol the licensed "one event with multiple Agent atoms" shape collapses to one Agent atom, so the collective reading is recorded only by the ABSENCE of the per-member distribution rule - indistinguishable from a parse that simply omitted it.
adjudication.defect_summary: "reached the Hollows" should be (Theme sk_reach_1 hollows), the same direct-object role the instruction set's "Sara reached the platform" example uses. Each distributive group event - burn, show, survive, flee, reach, leave - should carry a per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (And ...)) rule at (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the group event, exactly as the sky-cat descend/hunt/molt events do. The definite "The mist-light" should fill the Agent slot with a fresh typed individual, (Member sk_mist_light_1 mist_light), the bare kind symbol staying only in the earlier non-specific "produced / showed mist-light" mentions. "left silken threads" should be (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1).
adjudication.notes: The participle in "the surviving nightmoths" is recorded by no atom, though Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated modifier and the descriptive-modifier rule gives it a licensed form (distribution over sk_survivors_1's members). Name handling, group/Cardinality shape, compound decomposition and the During link are otherwise clean.
